provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design, via RulesPal)

steps.text: New players: start with the introductory games (Space Diamonds, Starship Builder, Race For Glory)
Sol Sunspot Cycle placard on its CORE GAME side; 4 translucent red disks over the Sol icon
Deal each player a random Crew; each secretly picks which side to play
steps.note: Norse Astronauts / SpaceX: borrow an unused colour as your grey

steps.text: Each player: a playmat with the Crew faceup in the LEO slot
Reserve in your colour: 2 Rockets, 1 Dry Mass and 1 Wet Mass chit, 7 Factory cubes, 7 Colony domes, 9 Claim disks, 2 Outpost chits
Shuffle the 6 patent decks (thruster, robonaut, refinery, generator, reactor, radiator) separately, White-Side up
6 Aqua beads into each player's LEO slot (one per patent deck)
A blue bead on each of the 6 starting spaces of the Exploitation Tracks
1 glory chit, 1 VP side up, on each Heliocentric Zone: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Ceres, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
A heroism chit on each of the 4 heroism spots
Use only White-Sides of patents until you build your first Factory
Remove a red disk each time the seniority threshold is crossed (each 12-year cycle)
Best clout (A highest) is 1st Player: they put a cube on the Sunspot Cycle start and take the first turn
